```yaml
name: Build Linux (No Container)

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      python-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      cuda-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      arch:
        required: true
        type: string
      upload:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, ${{ inputs.arch }}]
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

      - name: Setup CUDA
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux@main
        with:
          cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install uv
          uv pip install -e ".[test]"

      - name: Build wheel
        run: |
          python setup.py bdist_wheel

      - name: Determine wheel location
        id: wheel-location
        run: |
          WHEEL_FILE=$(ls dist/*.whl | head -n 1)
          echo "wheel_path=$WHEEL_FILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "wheel_name=$(basename $WHEEL_FILE)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload wheel artifact
        if: inputs.upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flash-attention-${{ inputs.arch }}-${{ inputs.python-version }}-${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          path: ${{ steps.wheel-location.outputs.wheel_path }}

      - name: Post-build cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Remove flash-attention source
          rm -rf flash-attention
          
          # Remove virtual environment if created
          if [ -d ".venv" ]; then
            rm -rf .venv
          fi
          
          # Clear pip cache
          pip cache purge
          
          # Clear uv cache
          uv cache clean
          
          # Remove CUDA temporary files if any
          rm -rf /tmp/cuda-*
          
          # Remove build artifacts
          rm -rf build/
          rm -rf dist/
          rm -rf *.egg-info
```
